package.name: agx_plane_target
package.description: Interactive red-dot target on the provisional safety plane: drag the dot anywhere on the plane (clamped to the yellow safety rectangle), click the GO button to send the gripper straight down onto the dot via MoveIt, and click the STOP button to cancel the current execution. The grasp service adds the closing half of a pick (move onto the dot, then close the gripper to a live-tunable target and report the reading it stopped at). The put service (PutPoint.srv, int32 point 1..6) places a held object on one of the six taught put points (measurements.md M6, link_base_lift0): move above the point, straight-line descent, open the gripper, straight-line lift, back to the SRDF initial pose; the six points are drawn as red spheres on /plane_target/put_points and the terminal CLI is scripts/put. The pick service (PickPoint.srv, same point numbers) is the reverse timing: from initial to the safety height above the point, straight descent, close to 200, straight lift, back to initial; CLI is scripts/pick. Task-layer node, depends on MoveIt from moveit_config; nothing in core/start may depend on this package.
